title: Cosmic Oracle Gathering
description: Three robed figures with celestial orbs for heads stand on a dark platform under a blood-red moon and starry sky. A large glowing purple orb containing a tentacled creature with a yellow eye emits lightning between them, while below a smaller orb shows silhouetted figures and ghostly hands reach upward from swirling mist.
prompt: surreal cosmic scene with three robed figures standing on a dark stone platform, their heads replaced by celestial orbs: one red with patterns, one purple with eyes, one white cratered like the moon. They wear ornate robes with fur and embroidery. Between them floats a large glowing purple sphere containing a colorful tentacled eldritch creature with a single yellow eye, emitting purple lightning. Below on a lower platform is a smaller glowing orb showing three silhouetted human figures inside. Ghostly hands reach up from swirling purple and grey mist. Broken classical columns with green ooze, a giant red moon in a starry sky with constellations, dramatic beams of light from above, dark fantasy atmosphere.
